### A Divine Appointment
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/a-divine-appointment
Passage: Acts 8:35
Points:
- Philip immediately obeyed God's call to leave a fruitful city ministry for an empty desert road.
- The Ethiopian official was a sincere seeker reading Isaiah 53 but lacking spiritual understanding.
- Philip used the prophetic text of the Suffering Servant to explain the Good News of Jesus.
- True Christian ministry relies on God's sovereign direction rather than human ideas of efficiency.
- Believers must stay open to God's leading when He directs them to minister to a single individual.

### Encounter on the Damascus Highway, Part Two
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/encounter-on-the-damascus-highway--part-two2
Passage: Acts 8:29-31
Points:
- Effective evangelism begins with being available when the Lord redirects our path.
- Philip walked in obedience and followed the Holy Spirit's guidance to approach the carriage.
- Rather than forcing a canned presentation, Philip initiated the conversation with a thoughtful question.
- When invited to explain Scripture, Philip spoke with tact and focused directly on Jesus Christ.
- Christians today should stay watchful for divine opportunities to come alongside seeking people.

### Our Job is to Be Faithful
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-august-26-2024.html
Passage: Acts 8:30-31
Points:
- Believers are called to faithful obedience rather than measuring success by numbers.
- The Holy Spirit is the ultimate soul-winner who works through obedient witnesses.
- Christians have the unique joy and privilege of explaining the salvation message to others.
- Philip avoided sidetracks and kept his conversation centered squarely on Jesus Christ.
- Believers should ask God to stir spiritual curiosity and seeking hearts in those around them.

### Philip and the Ethiopian Official
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-april-26-2025.html
Passage: Acts 8:35
Points:
- Philip showed immediate obedience by traveling to an isolated road without questioning the assignment.
- An influential foreign leader was hungry for truth and welcomed Philip to explain the Scriptures.
- Philip met the inquirer where he was, using the passage from Isaiah to point him to Christ.
- The official’s conversion and baptism helped carry the gospel to an entirely new region.
- Believers must recognize divine appointments and step out boldly to help others understand God's Word.
